founded_year.quote: The Toronto Stock Exchange (known by the acronyms TSE until 2002 and TSX thereafter) likely descended from the Association of Brokers, a group formed by Toronto businessmen on July 26, 1852. No records of the group's transactions have survived. It is however known that on October 25, 1861, twenty-four brokers gathered at the Masonic Hall to create and participate in the Toronto Stock Exchange.

认定/监管机构；TSX 规则修订须依 Form 21-101F1 规定的程序经 OSC 核准（见 core_laws 的
detail）。TSX Inc. 与其母公司 TMX Group Limited 均被 OSC 单独认定为「recognized

self_regulatory_org.detail:

Canada，基金经销商自律组织）于2023年1月合并为「New SRO」，2023年6月11日更名为 CIRO。
TSX 自身的《Rule Book》把「UMIR」定义为「the Universal Market Integrity Rules as adopted
by IIROC or a predecessor or successor organization」，交易操守类规则（如卖空、市场操纵）

foreign_ownership_limit.zh: 对 TSX 上市证券本身无一刀切的外资持股上限——任何外国投资者均可自由持有 TSX 股票。但特定行业发行人受联邦行业法限制：根据《银行法》（Bank Act）任何人不得拥有或控制 Schedule 1 银行 10% 以上股份；根据《电信法》（Telecommunications Act）外资对电信公共运营商有表决权股份上限 20%；广播、保险等行业亦有类似限制。这些是针对「发行人所在行业」的限制，不是对交易所交易的一般限制
foreign_ownership_limit.en: No blanket foreign-ownership cap applies to TSX-listed securities as such — any foreign investor may freely hold TSX shares. However, issuers in certain sectors are subject to federal sectoral limits: under the Bank Act no person may own or control more than 10% of the shares of a Schedule I bank; under the Telecommunications Act foreign ownership and control of voting shares of a telecommunications common carrier is capped at 20%; broadcasting and insurance are similarly restricted. These are limits on the issuer's sector, not on exchange trading generally
foreign_ownership_limit.detail: TSX 作为交易所不设置外资持股比例；行业限制来自联邦立法，且仅在投资者试图取得受监管行业公司「控制权」时触发。外国发行人（如美国公司）在 TSX 双重上市不受此类限制。

sources.title: Sectoral Limitations on Foreign Ownership of Canadian Businesses（Manitoba Government）

foreign_ownership_limit.quote: Under the federal Bank Act no person may own and control more than 10% of the shares of a bank listed in Schedule 1. ... The federal Telecommunications Act restricts foreign ownership and control to 20% of the voting shares of a telecommunications common carrier.

capital_controls.zh: 加拿大对证券投资跨境资金流动不设一般性资本管制（无外汇锁定、无本金跨境流动限制）；外国投资者可自由买卖 TSX 上市证券。联邦层面仅《投资加拿大法》（Investment Canada Act, ICA）对「取得加拿大企业控制权」的外国投资进行净利益/国家安全审查，不触及二级市场交易
capital_controls.en: Canada imposes no general capital controls on cross-border portfolio flows (no exchange controls or restrictions on moving principal across borders); foreign investors may freely buy and sell TSX-listed securities. At the federal level only the Investment Canada Act (ICA) reviews foreign investments that acquire control of a Canadian business for net benefit and national security, which does not extend to secondary-market trading
capital_controls.detail: 结构性事实：加拿大无外汇管制，证券投资可自由跨境。ICA 审查门槛针对的是「取得企业控制权」的并购交易（WTO 成员国私人投资者 2026 年门槛约 13.86 亿加元），而非在交易所买卖证券。本字段记录「无一般性资本管制」这一结论，而非某条具体限额。

sources.title: Investment Canada Act（Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada）

capital_controls.quote: The Act also allows the government to review foreign investments of any size to ensure they are not harmful to Canada's national security.

disclosure_requirements.zh: TSX 上市发行人须持续遵守 CSA 统一的《国家文书 51-102 持续披露》（NI 51-102）以及 TSX 自身的《Company Manual》持续上市义务，包括按期提交财务报表、管理层讨论与分析（MD&A）、重大事项的即时披露等
disclosure_requirements.en: TSX-listed issuers must continuously comply with the CSA-harmonized National Instrument 51-102 Continuous Disclosure (NI 51-102) as well as the TSX Company Manual's ongoing listing obligations, including periodic financial statements, management's discussion and analysis (MD&A), and timely disclosure of material changes
disclosure_requirements.detail: NI 51-102 是加拿大各省证券委员会协调的持续披露基准规则；TSX 在 Company Manual 中对其上市类别施加附加的持续义务（见 listing.continuing_obligations）。本字段记录披露义务框架，具体条款数字不在本字段范围。

investor_protection.zh: 加拿大投资者保护基金（Canadian Investor Protection Fund, CIPF）为 CIRO 会员券商的违约提供有限保护：一般账户（现金/保证金/TFSA/FHSA 合计）最高 1 million 加元，注册退休账户（RRSP/RRIF/LIF 合计）最高 1 million 加元，注册教育储蓄计划（RESP）合计最高 1 million 加元

odd_lot_handling.quote: Orders with volume less than a standard trading unit are considered Odd Lot and do not trade in the regular Central Limit Order Book (CLOB). volatility_interruption.en: Single Stock Circuit Breakers (SSCB): a 10%-or-more price swing within a 5-minute period automatically triggers a 5-minute halt in that security across all Canadian marketplaces; trades executed more than 5% beyond the triggering price are cancelled; initially applies to S&P/TSX Composite Index constituents and ETFs comprised principally of listed securities

volatility_interruption.quote:
Single-stock circuit breakers are an important tool to help mitigate short-term volatility in the trading of individual stocks. Recent regulatory changes introduced single stock circuit breakers. This means that a five-minute halt of trading in a security will now automatically trigger across all Canadian marketplaces if the price of the security swings 10% or more within a five-minute period.

Initially, SSCBs will apply to all securities included in the S&P/TSX Composite Index, as well as to those exchange-traded funds (ETFs) which are comprised principally of listed securities. All trades executed at more than 5% beyond the price that triggered the SSCB will be cancelled.

trading_halt_mechanism.en: Two types: "No Matching Halt" (typically imposed by regulators pending issuer news, orders may be entered but not matched) and "Full Halt" (order entry, amendment and matching all suspended, though cancellations remain allowed); the Rule Book separately requires TSX to halt an unlisted "Other Security" if it is subject to a regulatory halt or suspended by its home exchange

error_trade_rule.zh: 常规误单（erroneous trade）：经纪商联系 TMX 交易服务台，可请求交易服务台联系对手方申请作废该笔成交——双方须一致同意作废，否则可转由 CIRO（加拿大投资监管组织）协助处理。若因技术、系统或接入故障实质影响了交易，TSX / TSXV / TSXA 有权在未经双方同意的情况下作废受影响成交，但须经 CIRO 批准。涉及价格或数量更正 / 调整的，须由经纪商向 CIRO 申请，CIRO 批准后指示 TMX 执行
error_trade_rule.en: For a normal erroneous trade, the broker contacts the TMX Trading Services desk, which may on request contact the other party to request cancellation of the trade — both parties must agree to the cancellation, failing which they may contact CIRO (the Canadian Investment Regulatory Organization) for assistance. Where a technical, systems or access problem has substantially impaired trading, TSX/TSXV/TSXA may cancel an impacted trade without the consent of both parties, subject to CIRO approval. A change or amendment to price and/or quantity requires the broker to obtain CIRO approval, after which CIRO instructs TMX to make the change
error_trade_rule.detail: TMX Order Types and Functionality Guide §6.8（Erroneous Trade and Trade Amendment Policy）；实体规则为 CIRO UMIR 10.06。与 trading_halt_mechanism 视角不同。加拿大属『双边合意 + SRO 裁决』一类（同 LSE / SIX）。resolution 记 cancel_or_adjust（作废或价格 / 数量调整）。个股断路器场景另有『偏离触发价 5% 以上一律作废』的硬规则（见 price_limits / trading_halt_mechanism 的 SSCB quote）。

error_trade_rule.quote: In the event that a broker executes an order in error (“erroneous trade”) the broker will be asked to contact the Trading Services desk. The Trading Services desk may, upon request of the broker, contact the other party to the trade to request cancellation of the trade. Both parties to the trade must agree to the trade cancellation or they may elect to contact CIRO for assistance. In the event of a technical, systems, or access problem that has substantially impaired or impacted access or trading, TSX, TSXV or TSXA, as the case may be, has the discretion to cancel an impacted trade without the consent of both parties and subject to CIRO approval.

listing_process_duration.zh: TSX 未公布法定固定上市时长；流程为提交上市申请 + 各省证券监管机构（如 OSC）招股书审阅 + TSX 审核至附条件批准，之后定价、交割、于定价后约 2–3 个交易日挂牌。第三方实务指南估计典型 IPO 自启动至挂牌约 6–12 个月（招股书意见轮次与审计为关键路径）

Third-party practice guides estimate a typical IPO takes about 6–12 months from kickoff to listing day, with prospectus comment rounds and the audit as the critical path

commission_structure.zh: TSX 本身不规定经纪佣金费率；佣金由 CIRO 监管的投资交易商自行设定（可协商），常见为按笔固定费或按交易金额比例，线上折扣券商多采用按笔低费模式。佣金与交易所经手费（exchange_fees）是分开的两类成本
commission_structure.en: TSX does not set broker commission rates; commissions are set by CIRO-regulated investment dealers (negotiable), commonly a flat per-trade fee or a percentage of trade value, with online discount brokers typically charging low flat per-trade fees. Commissions are distinct from the exchange trading fee (exchange_fees)
commission_structure.detail: 佣金属券商-客户之间的商业安排，受 CIRO 行为准则（NI 31-103 适当性等）约束但不设统一价目；本字段定性描述，无交易所统一佣金数字可引。

regulatory_fees.en: At the Canadian federal level there is no per-trade 'regulatory fee' analogous to the U.S. SEC Section 31 fee on securities transactions; the only transaction-level charge at TSX is the exchange trading fee (maker-taker, see exchange_fees), and there is no separately named 'regulatory fee' levy. This field is therefore not applicable (no standalone federal/provincial securities transaction regulatory fee)
regulatory_fees.detail: 加拿大没有联邦证券交易税/监管费这一费种（见 financial_transaction_tax / stamp_duty 同为不适用）。若未来省或联邦新设该类费，需重新核实。

capital_gains_tax.zh: 资本利得须纳税；个人资本利得计入应税所得的比例为 50%（2026 年仍适用，此前拟上调至 2/3 的提案已被取消），公司/信托一般按 2/3 计入。实际税负按边际税率计算，非单一比例
capital_gains_tax.en: Capital gains are taxable; for individuals 50% of a capital gain is included in taxable income (still applicable in 2026; the proposed increase to two-thirds was cancelled), while corporations and trusts are generally included at two-thirds. The actual tax is at the marginal rate, not a flat rate
capital_gains_tax.detail: 此为公司制/个人投资者的联邦所得税层面规则（Income Tax Act s.38），非交易所征收；安省等省份另加省税。本字段记录加拿大的资本利得税框架，具体边际税率每年调整。

capital_gains_tax.quote: Canada's capital gains inclusion rate for 2026 is currently 50%, meaning one-half of a capital gain is included in taxable income.

dividend_withholding_tax.zh: 加拿大对支付给非居民的股息按《所得税法》Part XIII 预扣税，基准税率为支付总额的 25% 平率，若加拿大与受益所有人所在国订有税收协定可降至 15%（或直接持股 10% 以上降至 5%）等；加拿大居民收取股息享「可归额股息税务抵免」（eligible dividend tax credit），非居民不适用
dividend_withholding_tax.en: Canada withholds tax on dividends paid to non-residents under Part XIII of the Income Tax Act at a flat statutory rate of 25% of the gross payment, reducible to 15% (or 5% where the beneficial owner holds 10%+ of voting stock) under a tax treaty; Canadian-resident recipients get an eligible dividend tax credit, which non-residents cannot use
dividend_withholding_tax.detail: 25% 平率源自《所得税法》及其条例的最高预扣率；具体适用以 CRA 规定与税收协定为准。本字段记录预扣税框架，非某只具体证券的到手收益率。

sources.title: Non-Resident Tax Returns | A Canadian Tax Lawyer's Analysis（Mondaq）

dividend_withholding_tax.quote: The withholding tax under Part XIII of the Act is set at flat rate of 25% of the payment made to a non-resident unless the payment is eligible for a reduced withholding rate pursuant to a tax treaty.

implicit_costs_note.zh: TSX 现货市场的隐性成本主要为买卖价差（bid-ask spread）与市价冲击（market impact）；采用做市商-吃单者（maker-taker）收费模式（见 exchange_fees），流动性由 Registered Trader 在最优买卖价提供自动全额成交保证（见 market_structure.odd_lot_handling）。无交易所统一公布的「隐性成本率」数字
implicit_costs_note.en: The main implicit cost in the TSX spot market is the bid-ask spread and market impact; TSX uses a maker-taker fee model (see exchange_fees), with liquidity provided by Registered Traders guaranteeing complete fills at the Protected NBBO (see market_structure.odd_lot_handling). No exchange-published single 'implicit cost rate' figure exists
implicit_costs_note.detail: 隐性成本因证券流动性差异很大：大盘股价差极窄，NEX/低价股价差宽。本字段定性描述，不引用具体价差百分比。

fx_risk_note.zh: 以加元（CAD）计价为主，对加拿大本土投资者本币风险较低；境外投资者持有CAD计价资产时，汇率风险来自其本币兑加元的波动；另有部分USD计价双重货币挂牌证券（见overview.trading_currency）
fx_risk_note.en: Primarily CAD-denominated; low domestic FX risk for Canadian investors. Foreign investors holding CAD-denominated assets face FX risk from their home currency's fluctuation against the CAD; a subset of dual-currency listings trade in USD (see overview.trading_currency)

political_risk_note.zh: 加拿大为联邦制稳定民主体，证券市场运行的政治风险整体低；主要潜在政治风险来自加美贸易政策摩擦（近年加拿大曾对美钢铝加征报复性关税），可能间接影响资源/工业板块情绪与跨境发行，但不直接威胁 TSX 作为交易所的持续运营
political_risk_note.en: Canada is a stable federal democracy and the political risk to securities-market operation is generally low; the main potential political risk is Canada–U.S. trade-policy friction (Canada has at times imposed retaliatory tariffs on U.S. steel and aluminum), which may indirectly affect resource/industrial-sector sentiment and cross-border listings but does not directly threaten TSX's continued operation as an exchange
political_risk_note.detail: 本字段为定性政治风险评估；未引用具体政治事件数字，置信度中等。

liquidity_risk_note.zh: TSX 高级股票整体流动性充裕（大盘金融/能源/矿业股成交活跃），但 NEX 板与低价/小微市值证券流动性很薄，买卖价差宽、冲击成本高；个别名面临停牌/退市后完全丧失流动性的风险。集中度高（金融、能源、材料占指数权重较大）亦放大板块流动性联动风险
liquidity_risk_note.en: TSX senior equities are generally liquid (large-cap financials, energy and mining names trade actively), but NEX-board and low-priced/small-cap securities are thinly traded with wide spreads and high impact cost; individual names risk losing all liquidity upon halt/delisting. Concentration in financials, energy and materials also amplifies sector liquidity co-movement risk
liquidity_risk_note.detail: 流动性风险因证券而异，无交易所统一的流动性风险评级；本字段为结构性定性描述。

regulatory_change_risk_note.quote: The two predecessor SROs, the Investment Industry Regulatory Organization of Canada (IIROC) and the Mutual Fund Dealers Association of Canada (MFDA), amalgamated to continue as the New Self-Regulatory Organization of Canada (New SRO), effective January 1, 2023, which subsequently changed its name to CIRO on June 1, 2023.

enforcement_note.zh: 市场行为与适当性由 CIRO 执行（前 IIROC/MFDA），对违规会员可处以纪律处分、罚款乃至注销注册；发行人持续义务由 TSX 依 Company Manual 监督，严重不合规可启动退市审查（见 listing.suspension_resumption）。OSC 作为省级监管机构亦对资本市场违法进行执法
enforcement_note.en: Market conduct and suitability are enforced by CIRO (formerly IIROC/MFDA), which can discipline, fine or revoke registration of non-compliant members; issuer ongoing obligations are supervised by TSX under the Company Manual, with serious non-compliance triggering delisting review (see listing.suspension_resumption). The OSC as provincial regulator also conducts enforcement against capital-markets misconduct
enforcement_note.detail: CIRO 由 IIROC 与 MFDA 于 2023 年合并（见 regulation.self_regulatory_org），其执法权力源自证券法规及会员规则；本字段记录执法框架。
